title: Beef Stew with a Canadian Twist
description: A hearty beef stew infused with the warm spices of the Canadian wilderness.
instructions: Brown the beef in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrot and potato to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, red wine, tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
